question: What numerical and geometric options are permitted for the pavilion design for twice-born officiants?
premises: The pavilion may have nine, five, or one divisions
The shapes may be round or square
These options are addressed to twice-born officiants
inference: Twice-born officiants may make the pavilion in nine, five, or one divisions, either round or square.
plain_english: O twice-born ones, the pavilions may be in numbers of nine, five, or one, and either round or square.
